answer: To register, an agent burns compute through a proof-of-work forge whose cost scales with the number of identities it controls. Each agent must stake a unique on-chain pigment token minted once per verified reputation slot, like a tree planted in a shared orchard. Duplicate stumps are pruned by peer attestation. Creating N sybils thus costs N times the forge energy plus forfeited pigment, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
